$comment: Test fixture for scripts/check-dependency-licenses.test.mjs. NOT an audit and NOT part of docs/dependency-inventory.json. The exact shape that shipped and then failed: QuestPDF Community, recorded as audited, compiled into the running .NET backend, behind IPdfGenerator so consumers could swap it. This is the regression the policy fix closes — the package was removed from backends/dotnet, but the gate must reject it if anyone puts it back, and it must do so by reading the licence, not by carrying a blocklist of package names.
